text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love... a mysterious horsegirl who appeared suddenly from the twilight.
We moved elsewhere so I could hear the full story from her, but...
choice_data_list: (Huh?... She was right here just a second ago.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was definitely with me up to the entrance...
Yet looking around, she was nowhere to be seen.
choice_data_list: Still...?

text_block_list.text: Yes...
choice_data_list: Where did you go?... Still—
Where did you go?... Still—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I'm right here.
Right here...
choice_data_list: Waaah?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I am terribly sorry.
It seems... I have a faint presence...
choice_data_list: N-No, I should be sorry... for not noticing you.
N-No, I should be sorry... for not noticing you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love cast her eyes down apologetically.
Looking at her, feeling as though she might vanish if I looked away, I wondered anew—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could she truly be the exact same horsegirl I saw last night?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though filled with doubt, I refrained from prying too deeply...
First, I simply asked why she had been standing outside my room this morning.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I became so worried.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday... I carried you, um... to your room.
After that, I panicked... and I...
choice_data_list: Left me there, you mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed after I passed out, she carried me to my door...
and I somehow crawled into the entryway on my own. Muscle memory, perhaps.
choice_data_list: Still, how did you know which room was mine?
Still, how did you know which room was mine?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That's because... 'that girl' told me...—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, n-no...
...So, um...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even after returning to the dorm, wondering how you were... if you were unhurt...
I was so anxious, so worried, and so remorseful... that I came first thing in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am so, so sorry
for causing you so much trouble...!
choice_data_list: No, if anything, thank you for carrying me home...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though many questions lingered, it was finally sinking in.
The meek girl before me and the wild figure from last night... were indeed the same.
choice_data_list: By the way, about last night...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Please excuse me... I must go...!
choice_data_list: Ah, wait—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once she blended into the crowd, she was nowhere to be found—

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
The mark on your neck? ...Yeah, looks like a simple bug bite.
It is that time of year, so be careful out there. Here's some anti-itch cream.
choice_data_list: Ah,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mysterious mark on my neck was just an ordinary bug bite.
And Still in Love... was just an ordinary horsegirl who happened to fade into the background.
choice_data_list: (Was last night really just a bad dream...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps part of me wanted to forget those piercing crimson eyes.
Even as she lingered in the back of my mind, buried under the rush of daily work—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Little by little, the lingering afterglow of that night began to fade. Then came the day of the mock races I had helped prepare, just as the final heat was about to begin.
choice_data_list: (The sun is really starting to sink...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today's mock race brought together a field of fresh-faced Umamusume, all aiming to make their debut in the Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list: (I'll keep a sharp eye out for someone to scout.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The final heat gathered the most promising contenders. Every single one had a bright, spirited expression, brimming with hope and confidence—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, this won't do...
Everyone looks so dreadfully strong... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? There were supposed to be 17 runners, but...
we're missing one. ...Is Number 5 not here?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
...Maybe it's better if I just...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed no one else had noticed her presence.
Seeing her hesitate as if lacking the courage to step forward, I raised my hand in her place.
choice_data_list: Number 5 is ready too! Right over here!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Ah, apologies, I didn't see you there...!
Alright, everyone's here. Load into your gates!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It's... starting...
I can... let loose, right...?
choice_data_list: (Wait, what...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a split second, her frail silhouette stood out with razor-sharp intensity.
—Bathed in the sunset, glowing red... crimson.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—*she* emerged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At first, it was just a subtle sense of discord. Still in Love's running was sluggish, oddly stiff. As if...
choice_data_list: (As if she's holding something back—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
No... stop... don't come out...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No... please...! Stay... back...!
Everyone is so strong... giving it their all... running with everything they have—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: They look delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My heart thumps violently against my ribs. A cold shiver races down my spine, yet... I can't look away. Like the falling of night's shroud, her presence slowly overtakes everything—
choice_data_list: (It's her. The phantom from that night...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...!! Ahahaha, hahahaha!!
Give it to me, give it to me, GIVE IT TO MEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A complete turnaround. Trailing dead last only moments ago, Still in Love suddenly bursts into a blinding sprint, pouncing toward the lead pack. Her aberrant movements and sheer savagery freeze everyone in their tracks.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Let me drink in your power!!
—UNTIL EVERY LAST DROP OF BLOOD RUNS DRY!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, that madness vanished in the blink of an eye. Still in Love withered, losing all speed... and crossed the finish line dead last, in 17th place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The entire atmosphere shifted completely before and after the race.
Hope gave way to terror. And every pair of eyes was glued to Still in Love.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... what was that...?
That was way too creepy... Is she okay...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that just now...?
...Man, that gave me serious goosebumps...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No... you're wrong.
...I didn't...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I'm... I'm so sorr...
—I'm so sorry...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Squeezing out an apology, she took off running...
and I bolted after her on pure instinct—
